expected.reason_folder_excluded: world_unrelated_leftover is not level-name, level-name_nether, or level-name_the_end so worldFolderNames(for:) never lists it

notes: worldFolderNames(for:) (WorldSlotManager.swift:244-270) derives the Java candidate set as [level-name, level-name_nether, level-name_the_end] from server.properties, then filters to only the ones that actually exist on disk (lines 264-268) -- an arbitrary same-prefix folder that isn't one of the three canonical suffixes is never a candidate, so it can't leak into the archive by accident. createSlot (line 391) never touches the live folders themselves, only zips them into a brand-new slot directory.
